title: 955b turn presentation styles
body:
Fixes #955 
Supercedes #987 

Here is the logic for this version, @sanjayradadiya:
* game turn increments naturally, as before
* admin pages can be used to modify `turnPresentation` value
* `turnPresentation` is used to determine how to display turn number in UI

I've only found three locations where turn is rendered:
* `<TurnProgression/>` panel [here](https://serge-955b-turn-present-pppomi.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-molecules-turnprogression--with-phases&args=turnPresentation:Turn-Pairs)
* turn marker in list of chat messages [[here](https://serge-955b-turn-present-pppomi.herokuapp.com/storybook/?path=/story/local-templates-chatmessagesetup--demonstration&args=turnPresentation:Turn-Pairs)]
* turn marker in list of channel/custom messages
